prompt: Create a technical test scaffold for an accounting app with a dashboard, a double-entry ledger, and backend services. Include a README describing the goals to finish the scaffold, fix errors, un-slop the UI, and deploy to Render/AWS/GCP/Azure. Candidates may use AI but must log prompts and build sub-agents.
summary: Created pnpm/Turborepo monorepo: apps/web (Vite+React+Tailwind v4), apps/ledger-api and apps/reporting-api (Hono), packages/shared (money + reporting engine), packages/db (Drizzle Postgres + in-memory adapters), packages/ui (design system). Added Dockerfiles, render.yaml, cloud notes, AI log tooling, and starter sub-agents.

task: Scope down to a scaffold and add real-database options
prompt: No need to build the full app, just scaffold is okay. Mention using a real database like PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.
summary: Kept the dashboard pages intentionally minimal but compiling, and documented PostgreSQL (wired), MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite/libSQL and SQL Server as acceptable options behind the LedgerRepository port in docs/DATABASE.md. Added TODO(candidate) markers instead of building the full product.

task: Apply anti-slop design rules to the design system
prompt: Build the shared UI primitives so the dashboard looks like a product, not a template: one accent colour, no icon-in-rounded-square, no glassmorphism, no gradients, tabular money columns.
summary: packages/ui primitives use a zinc neutral base with a single indigo accent and semantic emerald/amber/red for state only. Icons are limited to navigation/actions via lucide-react. Stat has no decorative icon. docs/DESIGN.md records the enforced rules.

task: Verify typecheck, tests, build and runtime
prompt: Run pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and pnpm build, then smoke-test the built services and the internal-token boundary.
summary: Fixed real errors found: TS 'wholePart possibly undefined', Card title type clash, zod output typing in route validators, undici Response.json() typed as unknown in tests, tsup --no-external CLI misuse, and a node:crypto import that broke the browser bundle. All green; built APIs returned balanced trial balance and /api/internal returned 401 without the bearer token.

prompt: Create a PDF of guides for this technical test.
summary: Added scripts/build-guide.mjs: renders the markdown docs (README + docs/*.md) into a styled A4 HTML guide, then prints it with headless Chrome over the DevTools Protocol to get a 'Page N of M' footer. Built-in TOC (marked no longer emits heading ids, so the contents page is generated from the section list). Output: docs/ledgerlab-technical-test-guide.pdf (27 pages). Added pnpm guide:pdf and guide:html.

task: Add the client story (Warung Books) and fold it into the guide
prompt: Add a story: we have a client with a vibe-coded app who needs to go production scale.
summary: Wrote docs/CLIENT-STORY.md: Warung Books, a seed-stage bookkeeping app built by a non-technical founder with an AI app builder, now with 1,400 paying customers, a CPA review, a bank vendor security review and a seed round. Mapped each inherited defect to the challenge suite and to goals G0-G8, with KPIs, stakeholders, constraints and risks. Linked it from README and TASKS, and made it Part 1 of the guide with a new cover.

task: Add infrastructure plan and next-phase plan as scored deliverables
prompt: Need candidate to define infrastructure plan as well and planning for next development phase.
summary: Added two scored goals: G9 infrastructure plan (topology, environments, compute/scaling, RPO/RTO with a performed restore drill, networking/edge, secrets, CI/CD rollback, SLOs, cost model at 1x/3x/10x, failure modes, ADRs) and G10 next-phase development plan (measurable outcomes, RICE prioritisation, three milestones with exit criteria, capacity and next hires, workstreams, risks, metrics, explicit deferrals). Shipped both as fill-in templates, rebalanced the rubric to 100 with the two new criteria, extended TASKS, SUBMISSION and the client-story mandate table, and added them as Parts 10-11 of the guide (now 43 pages).

task: Fix Challenge A (trial balance asOf) and Challenge B (guarded void)
prompt: fix the two challenge bugs first, then commit
summary: A: buildTrialBalance now filters postings by entryDate <= asOf (matches buildBalanceSheet). B: only POSTED -> VOID is legal; memory and Postgres adapters throw ConflictError (409) otherwise; Postgres uses a conditional UPDATE ... WHERE status='POSTED' to stop concurrent double-voids. Port doc updated. Verified: test:challenges 4/4, typecheck, test (40), build, format:check green. Postgres path typechecks but is not exercised by tests yet (no DB). The agent also stripped the 'delete this comment' lines from the challenge specs; reverted so no test files are touched.

task: G1: core ledger correctness (inactive accounts, closed period, port contract tests, VOID report regressions)
prompt: let's move on to the real goals
summary: LedgerService rejects lines on inactive accounts (400) and refuses to post OR void entries dated on/before LEDGER_CLOSED_THROUGH (409); voiding is guarded because it changes a closed period as much as posting. Chose a single config date over a periods table (ponytail comment names the upgrade). Added a LedgerRepository contract suite run against in-memory and, with TEST_DATABASE_URL, Postgres: zero-sum invariant, adapter-level unbalanced rejection, atomic rollback on unknown account, single void, concurrent void race. Added shared reporting tests: VOID excluded from TB/IS/BS, inclusive date boundaries. CI now runs Postgres service + migration + challenge suite; turbo test task declares TEST_DATABASE_URL (strict env mode would drop it). Verified: mutation-checked each new service rule (removing it fails its test); contract suite 12/12 on a throwaway postgres:16 container; typecheck, test, challenges, build, format green. Agent's first mutation regex broke syntax and gave a false signal; re-ran with an exact match.

task: BIGINT money column and account deactivation endpoint
prompt: yes, use BIGINT. and add deactivate account endpoint.
summary: Added forward-only, guarded migration 0001 widening journal_lines.amount_minor to BIGINT (INTEGER capped a line at ~Rp 2.1bn); Drizzle reads it as a JS number; zod caps line input at safe integers and sumMinor rejects unsafe values/totals. migrate:sql now applies every migrations/*.sql in order and silences NOTICE spam. Added PATCH /api/accounts/:id {isActive} through port, both adapters and service (reactivation supported; strict body). Inactive-account test now uses real deactivation instead of a fake subclass. Verified on throwaway postgres:16: new contract test fails on the 0000 schema ('5000000000 is out of range for type integer'), passes after migrating; migration re-run is a no-op; full suite, challenges, build, format green.

task: G2: un-slop the dashboard UI (DESIGN.md) plus ledger filters
summary: Ran the app and audited every page against DESIGN.md before editing. Fixed real bugs: no navigation below md (added mobile nav), void errors swallowed (no catch; now shown inline), Reports rendered loading/error blocks inside card headers, Link wrapping Button (invalid nesting; added buttonClasses), /usr/bin/bash net income shown green. Design: stat-per-card grids replaced by one surface with hairline dividers; POSTED badges neutral (only exceptions coloured); account types plain text instead of accent badges; empty states no longer dashed boxes nested in cards; balance sheet/income statement sectioned with subtotals; balanced state quiet, out-of-balance gets an alert banner. Removed decorative nav icons and the now-unused lucide-react dep. Product quality: ledger status + inclusive date-range filters (new from/to on port, both adapters, route, contract test), aria-expanded rows, labelled controls, inline amount errors from parseAmountToMinor after blur, inactive accounts hidden from pickers, deactivate/reactivate on Accounts. Caught a Tailwind ordering bug (border-red-500 lost to base border-zinc-300 unless focused) via computed style; moved invalid styling to an aria-invalid variant in the shared Input. Verified in browser at 1280px and 375px (no page h-scroll), keyboard submit via Enter, filters, void styling; Postgres contract suite 18/18; full suite green.

task: G3: production-grade Postgres (integrity in SQL, deploy-step migrations, idempotent seed, pooling, health)
summary: Found and fixed: seed re-inserted every entry on each run (doubled the ledger); migrate:sql needed tsx (pruned from prod image) so migrations could not run as a deploy step; production silently fell back to in-memory without DATABASE_URL; entry_date VARCHAR + regex accepted 2026-02-31; N+1 queries (one per entry on list, one per line on create); shutdown closed the pool before draining requests. Added 0002_integrity.sql: DATE column, nonzero CHECK, deferred balance constraint trigger, append-only triggers (no line edits/deletes, no entry deletes, only POSTED->VOID). Plain-node migrate.mjs; removed drizzle-kit generate/migrate scripts that would fight it. Shared isoDateSchema replaces five regex copies. /health pings DB (503 degraded). Pool: DATABASE_POOL_MAX, idle/connect timeouts, documented budget. docker-compose local db. Verified on throwaway postgres:16: upgrade from 0000/0001 with existing VARCHAR-date data converts intact; migrations re-run clean; seed CLI 5 then 0; 5 raw-SQL tests prove DB rejects unbalanced/edits/deletes/bad dates; full suite 49 ledger tests; API e2e on Postgres incl. 503 with DB paused and production refusing to start without DATABASE_URL. Shell heredocs ate regex backslashes twice; switched those edits to the Edit tool.

task: G4: production-scale deploy (images, blueprint, rehearsal) + SQL report aggregation
summary: No cloud CLI/account on the machine, so the deploy is rehearsed locally with the exact images (deployment/docker-compose.prod.yml) and the Render blueprint is made deploy-ready; no fake URLs. Found: Dockerfiles ignored pnpm-lock.yaml; 'pnpm prune --prod || true' emptied workspace node_modules so the API images could not import postgres/drizzle/hono (masked by || true); render.yaml had 1 instance and no migration step; apps ignored . Fixed: tsup bundles all deps, runtime image = node + dist (137MB vs 317MB), bundled dist/migrate.js as preDeployCommand, numInstances 2, NODE_ENV production, CSP/HSTS on the static site, nginx CSP via runtime template, CI job builds images + migrates from image + boots API. Load test at real volume (62,010 lines) exposed reports loading every posting into JS (trial balance p50 1.56s, 6 req/s; reporting pulled all rows over HTTP). Added accountTotals to the port (SQL GROUP BY in Postgres, JS reference in memory), row-based report builders, internal /account-totals replacing raw /postings (less data exposed). After: trial balance 73 req/s p50 128ms p97.5 218ms; dashboard p97.5 248ms. Contract test proves SQL totals == JS reference across ranges incl. VOID and inclusive edges (51/51 on Postgres). Rolling stop of a replica: 300/300 requests 200, exit 0. Evidence in docs/evidence/G4-deploy-rehearsal.md.

task: G5: security hardening (secrets, CORS, internal boundary, headers, rate limits, least-privilege DB, audit)
summary: Found: CORS defaulted to * and /api/internal was open when INTERNAL_API_TOKEN unset (both automatic-fail risks in prod); token compared with !==; no API security headers, body limit or rate limit; app connected as DB owner (could TRUNCATE past the append-only triggers); drizzle-orm high advisory. Added @ledgerlab/shared/http (server-only entry): prod startup guards for CORS/token, constant-time token compare, secureHeaders for JSON APIs, 64KB body limit, per-IP fixed-window rate limit keyed on the proxy-appended XFF entry (ponytail: per-instance; Cloudflare is authoritative). 0003_app_role.sql grants ledgerlab_app SELECT/INSERT + column-level UPDATE only; migrations use MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL (owner). Wired into compose (init script creates the role from an env password via psql variable) and render.yaml. Upgraded drizzle 0.38->0.45.3, audit clean. Verified: unit + API tests, Postgres role test (workload ok; TRUNCATE/DELETE/DDL/DROP TRIGGER denied), rehearsal stack running as ledgerlab_app, 429s on a burst, prod containers refusing '*' CORS and missing token, token + DB password rotation. Caught my own false-positive rotation check (in-container loopback is trust in the postgres image); re-verified over the Docker network. Evidence: docs/evidence/G5-security.md.
